verses.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
lines: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

verses.text: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
lines: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so,
whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

verses.text: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
lines: And gathered out of the lands,
from the east and from the west,
from the north and from the south.

verses.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
lines: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way.
They found no city to live in.

verses.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
lines: Hungry and thirsty,
their soul fainted in them.

verses.text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
lines: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble,
and he delivered them out of their distresses,

verses.text: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
lines: he led them also by a straight way,
that they might go to a city to live in.

verses.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
lines: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness,
for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

verses.text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
lines: For he satisfies the longing soul.
He fills the hungry soul with good.

verses.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
lines: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death,
being bound in affliction and iron,

verses.text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
lines: because they rebelled against the words of God,
and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

verses.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
lines: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor.
They fell down, and there was no one to help.

verses.text: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
lines: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble,
and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
lines: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death,
and broke away their chains.

verses.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
lines: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness,
for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

verses.text: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
lines: For he has broken the gates of bronze,
and cut through bars of iron.

verses.text: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
lines: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience,
and because of their iniquities.

verses.text: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
lines: Their soul abhors all kinds of food.
They draw near to the gates of death.

verses.text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
lines: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble,
he saves them out of their distresses.

verses.text: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
lines: He sends his word, and heals them,
and delivers them from their graves.

verses.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
lines: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness,
for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

verses.text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
lines: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving,
and declare his deeds with singing.

verses.text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
lines: Those who go down to the sea in ships,
who do business in great waters;

verses.text: These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
lines: These see Yahweh’s deeds,
and his wonders in the deep.

verses.text: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
lines: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind,
which lifts up its waves.

verses.text: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
lines: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths.
Their soul melts away because of trouble.

verses.text: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
lines: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man,
and are at their wits’ end.

verses.text: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
lines: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble,
and he brings them out of their distress.

verses.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
lines: He makes the storm a calm,
so that its waves are still.

verses.text: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
lines: Then they are glad because it is calm,
so he brings them to their desired haven.

verses.text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
lines: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness,
for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

verses.text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
lines: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people,
and praise him in the seat of the elders.

verses.text: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
lines: He turns rivers into a desert,
water springs into a thirsty ground,

verses.text: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
lines: and a fruitful land into a salt waste,
for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

verses.text: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
lines: He turns a desert into a pool of water,
and a dry land into water springs.

verses.text: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
lines: There he makes the hungry live,
that they may prepare a city to live in,

verses.text: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
lines: sow fields, plant vineyards,
and reap the fruits of increase.

verses.text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
lines: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly.
He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

verses.text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
lines: Again, they are diminished and bowed down
through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

verses.text: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
lines: He pours contempt on princes,
and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

verses.text: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
lines: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction,
and increases their families like a flock.

verses.text: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
lines: The upright will see it, and be glad.
All the wicked will shut their mouths.

verses.text: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
lines: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things.
They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
